description: Export up to 1000 photos to disk JSON: file/capture time/dimensions/rating/flag/color_label/title/caption/GPS/location/keywords/keyword_paths (version 2 file, snake_case keys, string photo_id), no develop settings. Omitted photo_ids uses selection, or filmstrip if none. Prefer over per-photo get_photo_metadata. Returns exported count and destination; unknown IDs are not_found.

destination.description: Absolute path of the .json file to write; ~/ is expanded; only the platform's separator between names (/ on macOS, \ on Windows); no ., .. or empty names

overwrite.description: Replace the file if it already exists (default false: fail instead)

photo_ids.description: Array of photo IDs or file paths (default: current selection)

name: export_photo_metadata
title: Export photo metadata
